l4_steps.name: Analyse network demand vs slot inventory
l4_steps.input: O&D demand forecast for target IATA season
l4_steps.output: Airport-level demand vs slot-capacity gap list
l4_steps.kpi: Slot coverage ratio ≥95% of planned frequencies
l4_steps.pain_point: SkyCAST demand signals do not automatically map to coordinator-level slot granularity; manual crosswalk required for Level 3 airports

l4_steps.name: Prioritise slot request list by route value
l4_steps.input: Demand-gap list; route P&L rankings from prior season
l4_steps.output: Ranked slot request list with commercial priority scores
l4_steps.kpi: Top-20 revenue routes have slot requests filed within 5 days of season open
l4_steps.pain_point: SkyWORKS priority ranking may conflict with network-level schedule symmetry goals, requiring manual override

l4_steps.name: Extract historical slot series from IATA CRS
l4_steps.input: Equivalent season data: previous two years of operated series
l4_steps.output: Historical series report with utilisation rate per slot
l4_steps.kpi: Historical utilisation validated for 100% of held series within 3 business days
l4_steps.pain_point: IATA CRS data latency of up to 48 h means late-returned competitor slots are invisible during initial analysis, skewing capacity view

l4_steps.name: Assess 80/20 grandfather rights eligibility
l4_steps.output: Eligibility status per series: protected, at-risk, or lost
l4_steps.kpi: ≥98% of held series retain grandfather status; at-risk flag raised ≥10 weeks before conference
l4_steps.pain_point: Force majeure waiver criteria (e.g. COVID-era precedents) are interpreted inconsistently by airport coordinators, creating approval uncertainty

l4_steps.name: File force majeure exemption for at-risk series
l4_steps.input: At-risk series list; documented operational disruption evidence
l4_steps.output: Exemption submission with supporting evidence package
l4_steps.kpi: Exemption accepted by coordinator within 10 business days for 90% of filings
l4_steps.pain_point: Coordinator acceptance rates vary by airport authority; no standardised SLA exists under IATA WSG, exposing series to arbitrary rejection

l4_steps.name: Generate SSIM slot request messages in SkyWORKS
l4_steps.input: Ranked slot request list; confirmed fleet plan
l4_steps.output: SSIM-format Initial Slot Request (ISR) file per coordinated airport
l4_steps.kpi: Zero SSIM format errors on submission; ISR filed ≥8 weeks before IATA slot conference
l4_steps.pain_point: SkyWORKS SSIM export does not auto-validate against airport coordinator's declared coordination parameters (declared capacity), requiring manual cross-check

l4_steps.name: Submit Initial Slot Requests to coordinators
l4_steps.kpi: 100% of ISRs acknowledged within 48 h of IATA deadline; no late submissions
l4_steps.pain_point: Multiple national coordinators (e.g. Heathrow Airport Slots Ltd, DFW, CDG FAB) use non-standard portals alongside SCR, increasing coordination overhead

l4_steps.name: Review coordinator initial allocation returns
l4_steps.output: Gap analysis: requested vs allocated slots per airport
l4_steps.kpi: Gap analysis completed within 48 h of receiving allocation returns
l4_steps.pain_point: Allocation returns often partially match requests with no rationale, requiring reverse-engineering of coordinator capacity logic using OAG data

l4_steps.name: Prepare slot negotiation brief for conference
l4_steps.input: Gap analysis; competitor schedule data from OAG
l4_steps.output: Negotiation brief: priority gaps, swap targets, walk-away positions
l4_steps.kpi: Brief approved by VP Network Planning ≥5 days before conference
l4_steps.pain_point: SkySYM simulation does not model competitor reaction to slot swaps, limiting predictive accuracy of negotiation scenarios

l4_steps.name: Attend IATA slot conference and negotiate gaps
l4_steps.input: Negotiation brief; conference room bilateral schedule
l4_steps.output: Agreed slot swaps and bilateral exchange confirmations
l4_steps.kpi: ≥75% of priority gap slots resolved at conference; average delta from preferred time ≤15 min
l4_steps.pain_point: Airlines without alliance membership (e.g. unaligned LCCs) have reduced swap leverage at slot conferences; coordinators may favour legacy hub carriers

l4_steps.name: Escalate unresolved gaps to coordinator appeal panel
l4_steps.kpi: Appeals filed within 24 h of conference close; ruling received within 5 business days
l4_steps.pain_point: IATA World Slot Guidelines appeal process is non-binding; coordinators retain final authority, making outcomes unpredictable for non-dominant carriers

l4_steps.name: Import confirmed slots into SkyWORKS schedule
l4_steps.output: Updated master schedule with slot-locked departure/arrival times
l4_steps.kpi: 100% of confirmed slots imported without timing conflict within 2 business days of final allocation
l4_steps.pain_point: Slot times confirmed post-conference may conflict with crew pairing and aircraft routing already modelled in SkyWORKS, requiring full re-optimisation cycle

l4_steps.name: Publish confirmed SSIM to GDS and PSS
l4_steps.output: SSIM message distributed to Sabre GDS, Amadeus GDS, Travelport GDS, and Amadeus Altéa PSS
l4_steps.kpi: SSIM published within 5 business days of slot confirmation; GDS pick-up error rate <0.5%
l4_steps.pain_point: NDC API Gateway does not automatically ingest SSIM updates; NDC-sourced content requires separate manual schedule push, risking content divergence

l4_steps.name: Monitor weekly slot utilisation against 80% rule
l4_steps.input: Operated flight departure reports; slot series holdings
l4_steps.output: Weekly utilisation dashboard: series compliance status
l4_steps.kpi: Utilisation ≥80% maintained for all series; alerts triggered if any series falls below 85% buffer
l4_steps.pain_point: Altéa operational departure data lags coordinator reporting window by up to 72 h, creating risk of under-reporting in close-to-threshold series

l4_steps.name: Return or swap underutilised slots to coordinator
l4_steps.output: Slot return notification or swap offer filed with coordinator
l4_steps.kpi: Returns filed ≥6 weeks before operated date; 100% of below-threshold series actioned within 48 h of flag
l4_steps.pain_point: Late slot returns reduce secondary market swap opportunities; airlines that pool returns informally (Star Alliance, oneworld) gain competitive advantage unavailable to unaligned carriers

l4_steps.name: Archive season compliance evidence for grandfather rights
l4_steps.input: Full-season utilisation records; exemption filings; coordinator correspondence
l4_steps.output: Compliance evidence archive; grandfather rights assertion package for next equivalent season
l4_steps.kpi: Archive complete within 10 business days of season end; 100% of series have supporting evidence on record
l4_steps.pain_point: No industry-standard digital audit trail format exists; evidence quality varies by coordinator, creating litigation risk if grandfather rights are disputed
